units.name: Department of Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Official department doctoral programme and full actual PhD course table establish industrial engineering, OR, scheduling, inventory, supply chain and queueing remit; current faculty inventory maps actual department to School of Engineering.

units.name: Department of Business Administration
units.school: School of Economics and Administrative Sciences
units.evidence: Current academic inventory explicitly names actual Business Administration department; direct research page identifies revenue management/price optimisation, demand forecasting, resource allocation and operational analytics beyond one generic core course.

decisions.reason: Exact current Business Administration department, parent school and substantive Operations research remit independently verified.

sources.note: Entire official academic information-system PhD programme read. Exact English title Industry Engineering Ph. D. Degree Program and degree statement PhD in Industry Engineering; Level 8, qualification exam, doctoral thesis and five-professor jury. Explicit university legal-regulation name TOBB ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY. Research logistics, supply chain, scheduling, stochastic models and optimisation. English Industry/Industrial wording discrepancy preserved.

Entire Industrial Engineering graduate page Master section and separately opened Doctorate section read. Main department explicitly calls programme Industrial Engineering PhD, beginning spring 2011/12; doctoral original research, qualification/proposal/thesis, 21 credits plus seminar and ethics. Full doctoral course table Mathematics of OR, Supply Chains, Machine Scheduling, Inventory Control, Queue Theory, MDP and Reliability; master courses remain distinct.

Entire current Faculties and Institutes inventory read. Actual Industrial Engineering department under School of Engineering, Business Administration department under School of Economics and Administrative Sciences; Graduate Schools Engineering and Science, Economics and Social Sciences, Health Sciences. Main website uses TOBB ETÜ branding; no Tashkent campus merge.

Entire Business Administration graduate page and full MBA curriculum/course descriptions read in two successive body segments. Master only, with/without thesis, common Operations and SCM course plus ERP elective. No PhD business programme listed; one core course alone not unit scope evidence.

Entire actual Business Administration Research Topics page read. Explicit Revenue Management and Price Optimization research dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, resource allocation, analytical optimisation; Decision Theory operational analytics. Substantive Operations research remit beyond single MBA core course.

Current social graduate school home and expanded Graduate Programs menu read. 13-discipline list includes Business Administration/Finance/Economics and law/politics/psychology etc; mixed-degree menu not claimed full doctoral inventory. Business Administration actual master details read separately.

Entire Corporate overview/history rendered page read. Official TOBB ETÜ institution, university foundation/history, medicine/law and Ankara campus. No full alternative English name beyond TOBB ETÜ in this main page.

Entire International TOBB ETÜ in Brief page read, institution/cooperative education/three-term system and current official branding. Institutional identity established; common imported English word-order variant kept as source label.

limitations: Official academic information system English award wording Industry Engineering differs main department Industrial Engineering PhD. Same actual programme, no second award or department created.

Official academic regulation uses English TOBB Economics and Technology University; main site uses TOBB ETÜ. Imported TOBB University of Economics and Technology retained as same source-name variant, not separate provider.
Wider engineering and mathematical doctoral research fields not fully examined.
Business graduate MBA Operations/SCM core is not PhD; department eligible unit scope is separately substantiated by revenue-management research.
